textbookText: 25. The cofactor of an element aᵢⱼ is related to its minor Mᵢⱼ by: A) Cᵢⱼ = (−1)^(i+j) × Mᵢⱼ B) Cᵢⱼ = Mᵢⱼ always, with no sign change C) Cᵢⱼ = −Mᵢⱼ always D) Cᵢⱼ = Mᵢⱼ²
26. A diagonal matrix is a square matrix in which: A) All off-diagonal elements are zero B) All elements are equal C) All diagonal elements are zero D) It has no zero elements at all
27. For a matrix A and its inverse A⁻¹, the product satisfies: A) A × A⁻¹ = A⁻¹ × A = I (identity matrix) B) A × A⁻¹ = 0 (null matrix) C) A × A⁻¹ = A D) A × A⁻¹ = Aᵀ

28. The rank of a matrix relates to: A) The maximum number of linearly independent rows (or columns) in the matrix B) The total number of elements in the matrix C) The sum of all elements of the matrix D) The number of zero entries in the matrix
29. If two rows of a matrix are interchanged, the sign of its determinant: A) Changes (reverses sign) B) Remains exactly the same C) Becomes zero automatically D) Doubles in magnitude

30. Which statement correctly distinguishes matrices from determinants? A) A matrix is an array of numbers; a determinant is a single scalar number associated with a square matrix B) A matrix and a determinant are exactly the same mathematical object C) A determinant can be non-square, unlike a matrix D) Only determinants can be added or multiplied, not matrices
